subject: Problems to assess the Goodness of fit in distsamp models

messages.author: 031431f99cee8724
messages.subject: Problems to assess the Goodness of fit in distsamp models
parts:
Hi everyone,

I ran models with distsamp in unmarked, but when I assessed the Goodness of fit with point distances and function "exp" I got this error

Error in cp[i, j] <- u * integrate(grexp, db[j], db[j + 1], rate = rate[i],  :
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

The error does not occur when I use line transect or with other detection functions.

I tried the same analyis with the example data and I got the same error using point distances and the "exp" function.
This is the scriot to reproduce it,

data(issj)
str(issj)

jayumf <- unmarkedFrameDS(y=as.matrix(
issj[,1:3]),
 siteCovs=data.frame(scale(issj[,c("elevation","forest","chaparral")])),
 dist.breaks=c(0,100,200,300), unitsIn="m", survey="point")


hn <- distsamp(~1 ~1, jayumf)
neg <- distsamp(~1 ~1, jayumf,keyfun="exp")

# Function returning three fit-statistics.
fitstats <- function(fm) {
    observed <- getY(fm@data)
    expected <- fitted(fm)
    resids <- residuals(fm)
    sse <- sum(resids^2)
    chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected)
    freeTuke <- sum((sqrt(observed) - sqrt(expected))^2)
    out <- c(SSE=sse, Chisq=chisq, freemanTukey=freeTuke)
    return(out)
    }

(pb_hn <- parboot(hn, fitstats, nsim=25, report=1)) ### ok
(pb_neg <- parboot(neg, fitstats, nsim=25, report=1)) ## Error


Any ideas as to the problem?

Jaime
